featureName: Firmware Audit - Critical & High Priority Fixes
description: Critical safety bugs, functional gaps, and legacy parity fixes identified during comprehensive firmware audit. These must be resolved before deployment.

userStories.title: Add LaserController::update() call to hardware_loop
userStories.description: LaserController::update() contains the cartridge-removal safety interlock and maximum continuous on-time protection, but is NEVER called from the main loop or hardware_loop(). The safety interlock is completely dead code.
acceptanceCriteria: laserController.update() is called every iteration in hardware_loop()
Lasers are automatically disabled when cartridge is removed during laser operation
Lasers are automatically disabled after LASER_MAX_CONTINUOUS_ON_MS (30s)
No change to laser behavior during normal spectrophotometer readings
userStories.legacyReference: legacy-firmware/firmware/src/brevitest-firmware.ino:1419-1457 - Legacy turns lasers off immediately after each reading; no persistent safety loop needed. New firmware uses persistent enable/disable model requiring periodic safety checks.
userStories.notes: Single line addition to hardware_loop(). Legacy didn't need this because lasers were only on during blocking delayMicroseconds() calls.

userStories.title: Implement barcode type routing for magnetometer and stress test
userStories.description: All scanned barcodes are currently treated as cartridge UUIDs. Legacy firmware routes barcodes by type: BARCODE_TYPE_CARTRIDGE (1), BARCODE_TYPE_MAGNETOMETER (2), BARCODE_TYPE_STRESS_TEST (4). Missing routing means magnetometer validation and stress test cartridges cannot be used.
acceptanceCriteria: Barcode type is determined from scanned UUID format
BARCODE_TYPE_CARTRIDGE routes to VALIDATING_CARTRIDGE state
BARCODE_TYPE_MAGNETOMETER routes to VALIDATING_MAGNETOMETER state
BARCODE_TYPE_STRESS_TEST routes to STRESS_TESTING state with cycle count from barcode
Unknown barcode types set CartridgeState::INVALID and error
userStories.notes: Requires understanding barcode UUID format to determine type. Legacy uses get_barcode_type() function.

userStories.title: Fix motor wake delay to match legacy 10ms
userStories.description: HAL::motorWake() uses delayMicroseconds(1000) = 1ms. Legacy uses delayMicroseconds(10000) = 10ms. The A5985GETTR-T datasheet specifies wake time from sleep mode. Insufficient delay may cause missed initial steps.
acceptanceCriteria: HAL::motorWake() uses delayMicroseconds(10000) matching legacy
Motor reliably executes first steps after wake from sleep
userStories.notes: Single constant change. A5985 datasheet wake time is typ 1ms but legacy uses 10ms for margin.

userStories.title: Fix AS7341 clearInterrupt implementation
userStories.description: clearInterrupt() in the new firmware only reads STATUS_1 register but doesn't write-1-to-clear the interrupt bits. Per AS7341 datasheet, interrupt status bits are cleared by writing 1 to the respective bit positions. Note: legacy firmware also has this bug (declared but never implemented), but we should fix it for correctness.
acceptanceCriteria: clearInterrupt() reads STATUS_1 register then writes back the value to clear interrupt flags
Spectrophotometer readings complete without stale interrupt flags
userStories.legacyReference: legacy-firmware/firmware/src/DFRobot_AS7341.h:296 - clearInterrupt() declared but NOT implemented in legacy .cpp
userStories.notes: Legacy has same bug. Fix for correctness. AS7341 datasheet section 10.2.14 STATUS register.

userStories.title: Fix StorageManager checksum comparison bug
userStories.description: StorageManager::validateChecksum() compares uint32_t < 0, which is always false for unsigned types. This means checksum validation silently passes for corrupt data.
acceptanceCriteria: Checksum comparison uses correct signed/unsigned logic
Invalid checksums are properly detected and reported
userStories.notes: Bug is in the comparison logic. Need to read the specific code to determine correct fix.

userStories.title: Remove duplicate defines in main.ino that shadow HardwareConfig.h
userStories.description: main.ino lines 49-82 redefine 14 constants already defined in HardwareConfig.h. These duplicates create maintenance risk - if HardwareConfig.h values are updated, main.ino shadows them silently.
acceptanceCriteria: All duplicate #defines in main.ino that exist in HardwareConfig.h are removed
main.ino uses HardwareConfig.h values directly
Firmware compiles without warnings
userStories.notes: Must verify each constant exists in HardwareConfig.h before removing from main.ino

userStories.title: Fix TestRunner stopTest identical if/else branches
userStories.description: TestRunner::stopTest() has identical code in both if and else branches of a conditional. One branch likely has wrong behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: stopTest() if/else branches have distinct, correct behavior
Test cancellation and completion are handled differently as appropriate
userStories.notes: Need to read the specific code to determine correct fix for each branch.

userStories.title: Implement upload timeout caching
userStories.description: main.ino line 502 has TODO for caching test results when upload times out. Currently the test data is lost on upload timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: When upload times out, test record is cached via storageManager.cacheTestData()
User is notified via buzzer alert
Device transitions to IDLE after caching
userStories.notes: StorageManager::cacheTestData() already exists and is used in the upload callback. Just need to add it to the timeout path.
